tasks.title: Membership levels, class discounts and visits

steps.request: Gym members now get a discount on every class booking according to their membership level, the same level their member card shows: premium 20% off, plus 10% off, basic nothing. Drop-in guests pay the full price. The booking result reports the discount next to the total, as discount.

The front desk has lowered the bar for premium: from today a member is premium from 45 visits (it was 60). Last month members complained that their card showed one level and the booking charged another, so the card and the discount must always agree. Please keep it a small change, it goes out with today's release.

Booking classes as a member now counts as visits: every booked session is one visit (a booking of 4 yoga sessions and 2 spin sessions is 6 visits). The visits are on the member's card as soon as the booking is made, and they count for the member's level from the next booking on. A booking and the visits it adds must never get out of step. Drop-in guests get nothing.
